// Sample dataset for demonstration. All figures are illustrative, not live market data.
export type Category = "Mainboard" | "SME";
export type Exchange = "NSE" | "BSE" | "NSE, BSE";
export type Status = "Upcoming" | "Open" | "Closed" | "Listed";

export interface GmpPoint { date: string; gmp: number }
export interface Subscription { qib: number; nii: number; retail: number; employee?: number; total: number }
export interface Financial { year: string; revenue: number; ebitda: number; profit: number; netWorth: number; borrowings: number }

export interface Ipo {
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  symbol: string;
  sector: string;
  category: Category;
  exchange: Exchange;
  priceLow: number;
  priceHigh: number;
  lot: number;
  issueSizeCr: number;
  freshCr: number;
  ofsCr: number;
  open: string;
  close: string;
  allotment: string;
  listing: string;
  registrar: string;
  leadManager: string;
  about: string;
  gmpHistory: GmpPoint[];
  subscription?: Subscription;
  listingPrice?: number;
  currentPrice?: number;
  financials: Financial[];
  strengths: string[];
  risks: string[];
}

const DAY = 86400000;
const base = new Date();
base.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
const d = (offset: number) => new Date(base.getTime() + offset * DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

function gmpSeries(start: number, end: number, endOffset: number, days = 8): GmpPoint[] {
  return Array.from({ length: days }, (_, i) => {
    const t = i / (days - 1);
    const noise = Math.round(Math.sin(i * 1.7 + start) * Math.max(2, Math.abs(end - start) * 0.12));
    return { date: d(endOffset - (days - 1 - i)), gmp: Math.max(0, Math.round(start + (end - start) * t + (i === days - 1 ? 0 : noise))) };
  });
}

function fin(rev: number, margin: number): Financial[] {
  return ["FY23", "FY24", "FY25"].map((year, i) => {
    const r = Math.round(rev * Math.pow(1.22, i));
    return { year, revenue: r, ebitda: Math.round(r * (margin + 0.06)), profit: Math.round(r * margin), netWorth: Math.round(r * 0.55 * (1 + i * 0.2)), borrowings: Math.round(r * 0.18 * (1 - i * 0.1)) };
  });
}

type Seed = Omit<Ipo, "slug" | "open" | "close" | "allotment" | "listing" | "gmpHistory" | "financials" | "strengths" | "risks" | "registrar" | "leadManager"> & {
  openOff: number; gmpStart: number; gmpEnd: number; rev: number; margin: number; registrar?: string; leadManager?: string;
};

export const ipos: Ipo[] = seeds.map((s) => {
  const slug = s.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/(^-|-$)/g, "");
  const gmpEndOff = Math.min(s.openOff + 5, 0);
  const { openOff, gmpStart, gmpEnd, rev, margin, ...rest } = s;
  return {
    ...rest,
    slug,
    open: d(openOff),
    close: d(openOff + 2),
    allotment: d(openOff + 3),
    listing: d(openOff + 5),
    registrar: s.registrar ?? (s.category === "SME" ? "Bigshare Services" : "KFin Technologies"),
    leadManager: s.leadManager ?? (s.category === "SME" ? "Hem Securities" : "Axis Capital, ICICI Securities"),
    gmpHistory: gmpSeries(gmpStart, gmpEnd, gmpEndOff, openOff > 0 ? 4 : 8),
    financials: fin(rev, margin),
    strengths: ["Established customer relationships across key accounts", "Consistent revenue growth over the last three financial years", "Diversified product portfolio"],
    risks: ["Dependence on a limited number of customers for a large share of revenue", "Exposure to raw material price volatility", "Grey market premium is unofficial and can change sharply before listing"],
  };
});

export const todayIso = () => d(0);

export function statusOf(ipo: Ipo): Status {
  const t = todayIso();
  if (t < ipo.open) return "Upcoming";
  if (t <= ipo.close) return "Open";
  if (t < ipo.listing) return "Closed";
  return "Listed";
}

export const latestGmp = (ipo: Ipo) => ipo.gmpHistory[ipo.gmpHistory.length - 1]?.gmp ?? 0;
export const gmpPct = (ipo: Ipo) => (latestGmp(ipo) / ipo.priceHigh) * 100;
export const estListing = (ipo: Ipo) => ipo.priceHigh + latestGmp(ipo);
export const minInvestment = (ipo: Ipo) => ipo.priceHigh * ipo.lot;
export const listingGainPct = (ipo: Ipo) => (ipo.listingPrice ? ((ipo.listingPrice - ipo.priceHigh) / ipo.priceHigh) * 100 : undefined);
export const getIpo = (slug: string) => ipos.find((i) => i.slug === slug);

export const inr = (n: number) => "₹" + n.toLocaleString("en-IN");
export const cr = (n: number) => "₹" + n.toLocaleString("en-IN") + " Cr";
export const pct = (n: number, digits = 1) => (n > 0 ? "+" : "") + n.toFixed(digits) + "%";
export const MONTHS = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
export const WEEKDAYS = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"];
const parts = (iso: string) => { const [y, m, dd] = iso.split("-").map(Number); return { y: y!, m: m! - 1, d: dd! }; };
export const shortDate = (iso: string) => { const p = parts(iso); return `${String(p.d).padStart(2, "0")} ${MONTHS[p.m]!.slice(0, 3)}`; };
export const fmtDate = (iso: string) => `${shortDate(iso)} ${parts(iso).y}`;
export const longToday = () => { const iso = todayIso(); const p = parts(iso); return `${WEEKDAYS[new Date(p.y, p.m, p.d).getDay()]}, ${p.d} ${MONTHS[p.m]}`; };
